plainText:
Ash Ketchum is one of the main characters of the Pokémon Newspaper Strip. He is based on Ash Ketchum from .

==Character==
Ash is a Pokémon Trainer, and also attends a regular school. He and his classmate frequently lose their temper around each other and battle Pokémon. Ash lives with his mother Delia Ketchum, who often lectures him about his chores on the house, or about controlling his Pokémon. Ash's Pokémon often disobey him and attack him, and also sometimes damage his house and cause trouble at his school. His Pokémon often talk to each other, but humans can't understand their language.

==History==

Ash debuted in , where he began attending the same as . After an announcement that Pokémon Trainers may bring their Pokémon to school only if they are not disruptive, Misty and Ash said that each other's Pokémon should not be allowed for that reason, respectively, and they started to battle.

In , Ash and Misty complimented each other for their maturity, because they hadn't been fighting lately. Ash said that his Pikachu would win against Misty's Horsea, and they started to battle again.

In , Ash battled and eventually caught an apparently wild , which was eventually revealed to be .

In , 's Rapidash was defeated by Ash's Metapod.

In , Ash wore a costume for Halloween.

In , Ash was sent to the principal's office because Ash's Pikachu was outside its Poké Ball at school.

In , Ash started to train his Pokémon in practice battles against each other, but Ash was repeatedly struck by attacks.

In , his mother Delia Ketchum angrily told him to do the chores in the house, but Ash couldn't because he was trapped under his Snorlax.

In , at the night of Christmas Eve, Ash ordered Pikachu to shock someone making noise outside his house, not knowing it was Santa Claus.

In , Ash ordered their Pokémon to stay awake at the night of the New Year, but Ash himself fell asleep.

In , Ash witnessed Misty's Psyduck unleashing an energy explosion, but seemed unfazed by it and said that it is a worthless Pokémon.
